scope.surface: Composer footer with the persisted Plan interaction mode active

newScope: Existing idle and compact Composer states do not distinguish the active interaction mode from the default Build state.
The original T3 authority gives active Plan a distinct 1x16 separator, 28px blue control, 8px radius, 16px PencilRuler icon, Plan label, and truthful persisted interactionMode=plan state.
The active state must remain legible in both light and dark themes and must survive the Native persisted-session projection.
missingCoverage: Before this registration, the fixed denominator had no state that required Plan-specific content, geometry, typography, or material.
No retained same-snapshot Browser pair measured the active Plan control against the Web authority.
No retained exact-bundle Native run asserted the persisted Plan projection, control geometry, theme material, main transport, and cleanup together.
productLoss: The pre-fix Lynx control used the default Bot icon and muted treatment instead of the original active Plan composition.
The first active Plan raster was generated at 14px and scaled at render time instead of using the authority's exact 16px icon.
harnessMismatch: Native DevTool interaction-mode mutation attempts lost the active localhost:8903 response channel; those attempts are excluded from product attribution.
The first shared Browser runs selected renderer-specific draft routes instead of one canonical thread; those runs are excluded.
The admitted Browser harness clears the provider-update notification and navigates both renderers to the canonical environment/thread route after server readiness.
classification.evidenceBoundary: Registration changes only scope accounting. It does not reconstruct a synthetic pre-fix pixel score and gives no repair credit. All twelve new Lynx-for-Web and Native dimension cells remain conservative unknown until the current evidence point.

denominatorChange.reason: Persisted Plan mode is a user-reachable Composer state with distinct state truth, iconography, material, and theme requirements that are not represented by the default idle Composer state.
